node.statement: Put P_n=I_n tensor P and Q_n=I_n tensor Q. The amplified-corner identification used in the validated meaning of lem-compcb-rectangular-product gives M_n tensor S_{P,Q}=S_{P_n,Q_n} and M_n tensor S_{Q,P}=S_{Q_n,P_n}. Hence X_r lies in S_{Q_n,P_n} and X_c lies in S_{P_n,Q_n}; with the theorem variables (U,V,W)=(Q,P,Q), (X_r,X_c) is a genuinely compatible square amplified rectangular pair and its compressed product lands in S_{Q_n,Q_n}.
